messages:
caroline: FYI we need to push v2.14.3 to prod to fix the perf regression seen in /generate. ETA: today during the 17:00 UTC change window. who can actually run the prod deploy? I can't until MFA issue is sorted.
alex: I can do it but I'm showing MFA devices not verifying for about half the infra team. filing with @mfa-admin now.
mfa-admin: we're aware — 3rd party MFA provider degraded for ~30m, escalation ongoing. some SSO sessions still ok.
ben: if MFA is flaky we should avoid broad temporary tokens. can we do a scoped canary instead and hold full rollback/rollout until MFA stable?
jen: agree. we need a pinned artifact for the canary so rollback is trivial. recommend pin to v2.14.3+rev2026-03-20 (sha: 9f3b2d4).
caroline: noted. I uploaded the release notes to the release tracker and attached the pinned artifact: sha:9f3b2d4. canary targets inference-prod-blue (5 instances).
deploy-bot: deploy request received from alex: /deploy run --service inference --version v2.14.3-canary --targets inference-prod-blue --instances 5 --notes "perf fix canary"
deploy-bot: permission check failed for alex — MFA not verified for prod-deploy role. see /help-perms
alex: I retried and got the same. any way to bypass for a single run (audit trail preserved)?
sre-oncall: don't bypass global MFA. we can do a gated handoff: platform-lead or release manager with verified MFA can initiate the deploy and tag audit. that keeps least privilege.
platform-lead: I can take the handoff. will verify MFA now. once I run the canary I'll post the deploy-bot output and health checks.
caroline: thanks. plan: 1) pin artifact to v2.14.3+rev2026-03-20 2) platform-lead runs canary 3) wait 15m health checks 4) if green, schedule full rollout in change window; if not, rollback to v2.14.2 (sha: a1b2c3d).
ben: document rollback steps here so oncall can act if needed. snippet for rollback command: ```/deploy run --service inference --version v2.14.2 --force-rollback --targets inference-prod-*```
jen: also adding a pre-check: confirm KV cache warmup script ran on canary nodes. otherwise perf signals will be misleading.
platform-lead: MFA verified, starting canary now. running: `/deploy run --service inference --version v2.14.3-canary --targets inference-prod-blue --instances 5`
deploy-bot: canary deployment started at 1769004380. monitor: https://console.redwood.ai/deploys/1769004380
platform-lead: health checks passing (alloc/latency within expected). observing 1% higher tail-latency but throughput steady.
sre-oncall: watching logs; if tail-latency > 3x baseline for >10m we cut. otherwise proceed to full roll.
caroline: I'll pre-stage the full rollout notes and update the change window ticket. tagging @release-manager to approve final push once MFA fully recovered. :thumbsup:
mfa-admin: MFA provider reports partial restoration. rolling verification continues. will update in 10m.
ben: agree with conservative approach. keep the pinned version for the next hour to avoid accidental auto-rolls.
platform-lead: canary steady at +10m. keeping pinned artifact. awaiting release-manager for full rollout approval.
caroline: thanks everyone — logging this thread into the release ticket and will follow up with rollback timeline if anything degrades.
